subject: Quick question on the recent funding round
body:
Hi Tom,

Hope you’re doing well! I was looking over our recent coverage from tech.eu and had a quick question regarding the details of our funding round. Could you confirm if the reported amount matches what we have internally?

Thanks a lot!

Best,
Julius

events.reply: Hi Julius, which article and which figure do you mean? Send me the link. The public numbers are the ones we've already communicated: 7M in total, with the 5.7M seed in September 2025. If something looks wrong, ping me on Slack and we'll sort it out quickly. Tom
